description:
Source file defining data models and database access functions for a Tic-Tac-Toe backend.
It includes functions to convert database rows to dictionaries, manage game rooms, handle moves, and update game state.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _row_to_room(row: tuple)
methods.description: Converts a database row tuple into a dictionary representing a game room.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _row_to_move(row: tuple)
methods.description: Converts a database row tuple into a dictionary representing a move.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] find_room_by_code(code: str)
methods.description: Fetches a game room by its unique code.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_room(code: str, player_id: str)
methods.description: Creates a new game room with initial settings and a specific code.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] join_room(code: str, player_id: str)
methods.description: Allows a second player to join an ongoing room if available.

methods.name: Optional[int] get_room_id(code: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the internal database ID of a room given its code.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_moves(room_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all moves made in a given game room, ordered by move number.

methods.name: int next_move_number(room_id: int)
methods.description: Determines the next move number based on existing moves in the room.

methods.name: None add_move(room_id: int, move_number: int, player: str, row: int, col: int)
methods.description: Records a new move in the database for a specific game room.

methods.name: None update_room_state(code: str, board: str, next_turn: Optional[str], status: str)
methods.description: Updates the game board, next turn, and status of a room.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] reset_room(code: str)
methods.description: Resets a game room to its initial state, clearing moves and resetting board and turn.

ctags.name: add_move
ctags.pattern: /^def add_move(room_id: int, move_number: int, player: str, row: int, col: int) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (room_id: int, move_number: int, player: str, row: int, col: int)

ctags.name: create_room
ctags.pattern: /^def create_room(code: str, player_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: join_room
ctags.pattern: /^def join_room(code: str, player_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: update_room_state
ctags.pattern: /^def update_room_state(code: str, board: str, next_turn: Optional[str], status: str) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (code: str, board: str, next_turn: Optional[str], status: str)
